title.zh: 将奎松市第一立法区的罗斯福大道更名为 Fernando Poe Jr. 大道的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming Roosevelt Avenue Located in Legislative District I of Quezon City as Fernando Poe Jr. Avenue
title.orig: An Act Renaming Roosevelt Avenue Located in Legislative District I of Quezon City as Fernando Poe Jr. Avenue
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Đại lộ Roosevelt nằm trong Quận Lập pháp I của Thành phố Quezon thành Đại lộ Fernando Poe Jr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อถนนโรสเวลต์ซึ่งตั้งอยู่ในเขตเลือกตั้งที่หนึ่งของนครเกซอนเป็นถนนเฟอร์นันโดโปเอจูเนียร์
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengganti Nama Jalan Roosevelt yang Terletak di Distrik Legislatif I Kota Quezon menjadi Jalan Fernando Poe Jr.
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Lebuhraya Roosevelt yang Terletak di Daerah Perundangan I Bandar Quezon kepada Lebuhraya Fernando Poe Jr.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11608_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Roosevelt Avenue located in Legislative District I of Quezon City is hereby renamed as Fernando Poe Jr. Avenue.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders, and circulars to implement the provisions of this Act within sixty (60) days from its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
